controls.description: The controls whose attestation check reads it.

items.description: A control's ID, as listControls names it.

detail.description: What waits, or that nothing does, in a sentence.
examples: The access review of Q3 2026 waits for an Owner's attestation, due by 14 Oct 2026.

due_on.description: When the earliest waiting item falls due; for the risk reviews, the next review date.

examples: Each quarter's attestation, with the report attested and its SHA-256, and a CSV of it

last_sign_off.description: The latest sign-off; none before the first.

overdue.description: How many of them are past their time.

owner.description: The role that signs it off; member when each member signs for themselves.

period.description: The period that waits, as people say it.

status.description: overdue: something waits past its time; due: something waits within it; signed: nothing waits and it was signed off before; nothing_due: nothing waits and nothing was ever signed off; not_applicable: the team mode does not call for it.

title.description: What it is, in a sentence.
examples: An Owner attests the access review (each quarter)

waiting.description: How many items wait for their sign-off.

where.description: The web app's page where it is signed off.
